title.zh: 修正第八百九十八号法的法案，将巴拉巴克岛梅尔维尔角关闭为入境口岸，并将巴拉巴克岛巴拉巴克设为入境口岸，同时为巴拉巴克口岸配备必要办公人员
title.en: AN ACT SO AMENDING ACT NUMBERED EIGHT HUNDRED AND NINETY-EIGHT AS TO CLOSE CAPE MELVILLE, BALABAC ISLAND, AS A PORT OF ENTRY, AND CREATING BALABAC, ISLAND OF BALABAC, AS A PORT OF ENTRY, AND PROVIDING FOR THE NECESSARY OFFICE FORCE AT THE PORT OF BALABAC.
title.orig: AN ACT SO AMENDING ACT NUMBERED EIGHT HUNDRED AND NINETY-EIGHT AS TO CLOSE CAPE MELVILLE, BALABAC ISLAND, AS A PORT OF ENTRY, AND CREATING BALABAC, ISLAND OF BALABAC, AS A PORT OF ENTRY, AND PROVIDING FOR THE NECESSARY OFFICE FORCE AT THE PORT OF BALABAC.
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật số Tám trăm chín mươi tám nhằm đóng Cảng nhập cảnh Cape Melville trên đảo Balabac và thiết lập Cảng nhập cảnh Balabac trên đảo Balabac, đồng thời bố trí lực lượng nhân sự văn phòng cần thiết tại Cảng Balabac
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่แปดร้อยเก้าสิบแปดเพื่อปิดแหลมเมลวิลล์บนเกาะบาลาบักเป็นท่าเรือเข้าประเทศและจัดตั้งบาลาบักบนเกาะบาลาบักเป็นท่าเรือเข้าประเทศพร้อมจัดเตรียมกำลังเจ้าหน้าที่สำนักงานที่จำเป็นที่ท่าเรือบาลาบัก
title.id: Undang-Undang yang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor Delapan Ratus Sembilan Puluh Delapan guna menutup Cape Melville di Pulau Balabac sebagai pelabuhan masuk dan menjadikan Balabac di Pulau Balabac sebagai pelabuhan masuk serta menyediakan tenaga pegawai kantor yang diperlukan di Pelabuhan Balabac

text.en:
Section two of Act Numbered Eight hundred and ninety-eight, entitled "An Act providing for the
closing of the port of Aparri as a port of entry, creating the ports of Bongao, Cape Melville, Balabac Island,
and Puerto Princesa ports of entry, and amending section three hundred and one of Act Numbered Three
hundred and fifty-five," is hereby so amended as to read  follows:

" The port of Bongao, in the Jolo collection district, and the ports of Balabac, Balabac Island, and
Puerto Princesa, in the Manila collection district, are hereby created ports of entry."
Section 2. The collector of customs and employees authorized by section three of said Act Numbered Eight
hundred and ninety-eight, for the port of Cape Melville, are hereby authorized for the port of Balabac,
instead of for the port of Cape Melville.

Section six of said Act Numbered Eight hundred and ninety-eight is hereby amended by striking
out the words "Cape Melville, Balabac Island," and inserting in lieu thereof the words "Balabac, on Balabac

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission in
the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 25, 1904.
